job.title: Cryogenic Test Engineer
job.description:
Title: Junior Engineer - Cryogenic Test

Headcount: 1

Location: On-site

Contract: Undetermined duration with possibility of continuation; Start: ASAP

Interview Process: 1st round interview; Feedback SLA: Weekly sync

Why Hiring:

- Workforce increase to address a team bottleneck at human resources across multiple R&D projects.

End Product:

- Quantum computing infrastructure, specifically superconducting control circuitry integrated next to qubit chips for control pulses, read-out, processing, and quantum state manipulation.

Tech/Domain Environment:

- MATLAB, Python

- Dry systems, cryostats, dilution refrigerators, and adiabatic demagnetization refrigerators (ADRs)

- Low-noise analog and digital circuits, electronic sockets

- Superconducting chips

Job Duties (6-10 bullets):

- Load superconducting chips into the cryogenic system and run test scripts manually

- Handle equipment carefully during manual R&D testing (up to 10 chips per day)

- Analyze test failure data and troubleshoot/debug non-working test runs

- Interact with circuit designers to explain testing results and anomalies

- Assist circuit designers in reproducing test issues via simulation

- Optimize the design and parameters of barely working R&D circuits

- Program test equipment to generate input signal timing diagrams from circuit designer specs

- Support exploratory debugging rather than push-button automated testing

Must Haves (hard gates; 6-12 bullets, all testable/quantified):

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics or Electrical Engineering

- Proficiency in writing and executing test scripts using MATLAB or Python

- Experience with electronic socket testing and low-noise analog and digital circuits

- Familiarity with testing quantum devices or superconducting chips

- Strong analytical skills for debugging non-working R&D circuits and analyzing test data

Nice to Haves (5-10 bullets):

- Familiarity with cryogenic testing, dry systems, and cryo-coolers

- Experience operating and testing in dilution refrigerators

- Experience with adiabatic demagnetization refrigerators (ADRs)

- Prior hands-on lab experience testing superconducting circuits during academic education

- Experience from organizations downsizing hardware/superconducting test teams (e.g., Northrop Grumman)

Disqualifiers (3-6 bullets):

- Expectation of purely push-button, automated testing without exploratory debugging

- Lack of programming proficiency in MATLAB or Python

Security/Clearance:

- None specified

job.title: Engineer Software 2
job.description:
Location: Sunnyvale, CA
Duration: 12 months

JOB DESCRIPTION

Northrop Grumman is looking for an Engineer Software 2 with extensive LabVIEW programming experience related to automated test development. As a member of the Marine System Engineering department you’ll get to develop the next generation test stand data acquisition system using the LabVIEW programming language. This position will serve on-site at Sunnyvale, CA

Responsibilities:

  • Designs and develops data acquisition software using LabVIEW programming language for production FAT testing of various products and programs.  
  • Develop user manuals for the test operators, support continuous improvement development, troubleshoot test software issue, incorporate analytical tools and automated report generation.  
  • Develop tools in support of the test preparation, post data analysis, issue tracking, and test performance metrics.  
  • Develop tools for test metrics trending with statistical analysis reports.  
  • Develop training curriculum and material to train engineers on test stand LabVIEW software programming, coding standards, architectures, etc.  
  • Lead team in LabVIEW programming for test stand software for FAT testing.   
  • Provide software maintenance, support, and future development.   
  • Collaborate with team members is assessing data acquisition hardware and software requirements and specifications for upgraded or new DAS architecture.  
  • Ensure appropriate software standards and practices are adhered to throughout the development process.  
  • Experience with NI PXI platform, PLCs.  Program Allen Bradley PLC ladder logic.

Basic Qualifications for Engineer Software 2

  • Experience developing test software using LabVIEW programming language.
  • NI LabVIEW Certified LabVIEW Developer (CLD) certification
  • Familiar with PLC ladder logic programming and communication protocols, EtherNet\IP and Modbus.


Preferred Qualifications for Engineer Software 2

  • 5+ years’ experience developing test software using LabVIEW programming language.
  • NI LabVIEW Certified LabVIEW Architect (CLA) certification
  • Experience with Allen Bradley PLC ladder logic programming and communication protocols, EtherNet/IP and Modbus.

job.title: CAD CAM 3
job.description:
Title: Engineer – CAD CAM 3
Location: Chandler, AZ

Why Hiring: Need for experienced PWB design engineers; Support for military/aerospace avionics projects 
End Product: Printed wiring boards for military/aerospace avionics

Tech/Domain Environment:
  • Cadence Allegro, OrCAD Layout, Mentor PADS, Xpedition
  • Windows OS
  • IPC-2221, IPC-7351
  • CAM350, Valor DFM
Job Duties:
  • Design/layout printed wiring boards for military/aerospace applications - Communicate project status to management
  • Collaborate with circuit and mechanical engineers
  • Participate in peer and design milestone reviews - Prepare artwork (ODB++, Gerbers) for PWB fabrication
  • Manage footprint/symbol creation and library
Must Haves:
  • 5+ years PWB design layout experience using Cadence Allegro in production
  • Experience with multilayer boards (6-16 layers) in production
  •  Layout/routing experience for digital and analog circuits in production
  •  Experience with high-speed digital and controlled-impedance circuits (SERDES, DDR3/DDR4) in production
  • Experience with rigid-flex assemblies in production
  • Ability to prepare ODB++ and Gerbers for PWB fabrication in production
  • Extensive experience with footprint/symbol creation and library management in production
  • Understanding of IPC-2221 and IPC-7351 specifications in production
Nice to Haves:
  • Understanding of Printed Wiring Assembly manufacturing process
  •  Experience with CAM350 and/or Valor DFM software tools
  • Experience with OrCAD Layout and Mentor PADS or Xpedition tool suites
Disqualifiers:
  • No PWB design experience
  •  Only academic/POC experience with Cadence Allegro
  • No experience with multilayer boards
